sources.title: W3C WCAG 2.2
sources.applicability: Complete pages and processes; individual success criteria have distinct applicability and exceptions.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG modal dialog
sources.applicability: Modal dialogs; test supported browser and assistive-technology combinations.

sources.title: GOV.UK validation
sources.applicability: Service forms; earlier validation requires task-specific justification.

sources.title: Altitude Elevation
sources.applicability: Altitude visual language; not evidence of improved human performance.

sources.title: Task-context review
sources.applicability: Actual audience, terminology and consequences require review.

sources.title: Hold-to-confirm task benefit
sources.applicability: Scoped option only; no universal destructive-action mandate.

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group: toggle-switch guidelines
sources.applicability: Binary settings that take effect immediately; settings saved with a form use checkboxes or other controls submitted together.

sources.title: OWASP Authentication Cheat Sheet
sources.applicability: Authentication responses, error messages and rate limiting; implementation security remains the application's.

sources.title: Altitude Fundamentals
sources.applicability: The established design laws generated interfaces break, and the Altitude rule that answers each; not evidence of improved human performance.

sources.title: Deceptive designs in LLM-generated interfaces (Chen et al., arXiv 2502.13499; Krauß et al., CHI 2025)
sources.applicability: Ecommerce and sign-up components generated by language models; prevalence findings, not a complete taxonomy.

sources.title: Altitude design guide
sources.applicability: Every screen built with Altitude: the laws, content, colour and component use.

sources.title: Altitude Charts
sources.applicability: Every chart, stat and meter.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG disclosure
sources.applicability: Button-operated show/hide content; expanded state and optional controls relationship, not an overlay-choice mandate.

sources.title: Android canonical list-detail layouts
sources.applicability: List/detail state and selection across available sizes; application to web composition is contextual, not a required breakpoint or evidence of Altitude effectiveness.

sources.title: GOV.UK Details
sources.applicability: Optional information disclosure in service pages; essential information remains visible. Does not validate record popovers.

sources.title: Wolfe: Guided Search 6.0 (2021)
sources.applicability: Visual search guidance by task, features and scene meaning; applying this model to screen composition is an inference, not an Altitude effectiveness result.

sources.title: McDougall, Curry and de Bruijn: Measuring symbol and icon characteristics (1999)
sources.applicability: Familiarity, complexity and semantic distance are distinct icon characteristics; no universal icon-over-text benefit or icon-count requirement follows.

sources.title: Issue 617: maintainer recognition-cue preference summary
sources.applicability: November 6–7, 2026 personal comparisons motivate a recognition question; preserve rejected options, low-rated relative winners and uncertainty. Not population-level evidence.

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group: applying filters (batch versus interactive)
sources.applicability: Faceted search and filters; batch application with Apply when criteria are clear or responses can be slow.

sources.title: Algolia RefinementList
sources.applicability: Search-engine facet values and counts; selected values can vanish from a response and counts describe the current search context.

sources.title: Baymard Institute: always use thumbnails for additional product images
sources.applicability: Product pages with several images or previews; benchmark of e-commerce sites, not of every catalog.
